blockingFindings.description: V16 crouch and sit renders still crowd the under-shorts and thighs at the inner hip crease. These fixed views do not establish continuous boundary coverage, clearance or strain; shorts fit remains unverified and rejected.

The V16 back view still has an angular raised block at center back, and crouch/sit retain two narrow pointed cloth tails below the seat. Moving the eight-cycle fold phase by pi/8 did not remove these visible defects. Silhouette and pose deformation remain rejected.
V16 front, side, arms-up and arm-cross renders still show triangular faceting across sleeves, shoulders, side torso and waist. Surface quality is rejected.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
